name: Severe thunderstorms and derechos – Windsor–Québec corridor
description: On 21 May 2022 a derecho travelled 1,000 km from Sarnia to Québec city in nine hours; 11 people died, more than a million hydro customers lost power and damage topped one billion dollars (sixth-largest insured loss in Canadian history at the time).

practical_implications: Tree-fall damage and outages; summer storm preparedness

verification.notes: Event facts quoted or paraphrased from the cited official pages on 2026-10-30. Exposure and implications are agent-04 interpretation.

limitations: Single event; tornado climatology not covered. Past events show exposure; they are not a prediction for any particular year. Exposure varies street by street – check municipal and provincial hazard maps for a specific property.
